title_zh: 先核对规则再筹备慈善抽奖

scenario.goal_zh: 确定筹款用途、奖品和筹备分工，并约定售票前核对活动规则

context_zh: 社区志愿者伊芙与哈立尔讨论一项尚未启动的虚构小型慈善抽奖。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Eve
sentences.text: Could a small lottery help us raise money for the reading room?

sentences.speaker: Khalil
sentences.text: Perhaps, but we need to check the rules before we sell any tickets.

sentences.speaker: Eve
sentences.text: The bookshop has offered a book hamper as a prize. I'd like all the proceeds to go towards new reading lamps.

sentences.speaker: Khalil
sentences.text: That gives us a clear purpose. I'll ask the community centre which rules apply and who needs to approve the event.

sentences.speaker: Eve
sentences.text: I'll confirm the donated prize and draft a notice, but I won't print tickets yet.

sentences.speaker: Khalil
sentences.text: Good. Once we have the guidance, we can decide whether to go ahead and set a date.

targets.sense_zh: 通过随机抽取决定中奖者的筹款抽奖
